# Data, Persistence and Offline Checklist: Shopping Lists

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for stored data, persistence, storage failures, first launch and offline use are complete, clear, consistent and measurable before implementation starts
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), with [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [contracts/driven-ports.md](../contracts/driven-ports.md), [contracts/driving-ports.md](../contracts/driving-ports.md) and [research.md](../research.md) R4, R5, R8, R9, R18, R19

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Audience and depth**: reviewer, standard depth, used as a gate before `/speckit-implement`. Screen states, feedback and accessibility are covered by [ux.md](ux.md) and are not repeated here.

## Persistence and Durability

- [ ] CHK001 - Is "saved on the device as soon as it is made" (FR-028) defined as durable against a power loss or device restart, not only an application kill, so SC-007 ("device restarted") is backed by a requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does the spec state that each user action is saved all or nothing, for the actions that change several records ("Terminer les courses" on many items, creating an article and adding it to the list), or does that rule live only in the `UnitOfWork` contract? [Gap, Traceability, Spec §FR-007, Spec §US2-7, Contract §UnitOfWork]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the restore made by "Annuler" covered by the same persistence rule as other changes (saved at once, kept after a kill), and is it listed among the changes SC-007 protects? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is it stated that a removal whose undo offer ended because the application was closed or killed stays final on reopening, consistent with "the removal takes effect immediately"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 - Does SC-007 list every kind of change the spec allows, including category creation and finishing shopping, or is "creation" meant to cover articles, categories and lists alike? [Completeness, Spec §SC-007]

## Storage Failures and Recovery

- [ ] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for a failure while restoring a removed item with "Annuler" (is the item lost, is the offer kept, which message is shown)? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are requirements defined for a failure of "Terminer les courses" (no item changed, the dialog closes or stays, message shown)? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the behavior specified when the application cannot start because the database cannot be opened, migrated or seeded: which state is shown, is retry offered as in US1-12, and is the error reported? [Gap, Spec §US1-12, Tasks §T062]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the case of a full device storage either given its own message or explicitly covered by the generic "storage fails" edge case? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is it specified what happens to data that is already on the device when a write fails: is earlier data guaranteed intact, and is a partly written action impossible? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are requirements defined for rapid repeated taps on the same item while an earlier tick is still being saved, including which state an item returns to when one of several queued saves fails? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Data Rules and Invariants

- [ ] CHK012 - Is the treatment of accents in name uniqueness specified in the spec? The data model keeps accents ("Pâte" and "Pâté" are different), while search ignores them (FR-009). [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-021, Data Model §Name]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is it specified whether names that differ only in inner spaces ("Pommes  de terre") or in Unicode composition (a precomposed "é" and "e" + combining accent) count as the same name? [Gap, Edge Case, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is "60 characters" defined in a unit that the domain check and the storage constraint count the same way (characters as the user sees them, code points or UTF-16 units), so a name with emoji cannot satisfy one check and fail the other? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-022, Data Model §SQLite schema]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are upper bounds or precision limits defined for quantities (largest amount, number of decimal places, how "1,333333" is shown)? [Gap, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are inputs such as "1 000", "1e3", "1,5,2" or a leading "+" either specified as refused or accepted, beyond the decimal comma and point rule? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §FR-016, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is it stated whether a quantity is stored and shown exactly as typed ("1,50 kg") or normalized ("1,5 kg")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Spec §US2-2]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is "exactly one list is current at any time" (FR-002) stated together with the rule that lists cannot be deleted, so its proof does not depend on a reader linking the Assumptions? [Traceability, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is the position of a user-created category relative to the defaults stated as a stored order that survives restarts, and is it consistent between the Category entity and the data model's `max(position) + 1` rule? [Consistency, Spec §Entities, Data Model §Category]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is it clear whether an article can be added to, removed from or have its quantity changed on a list other than the current one? US2-5 adds "Farine" to "Gâteau" without saying that list is current, while the add screen targets the current list. [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §US2-5]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are the entities listed in the spec and the entities and tables in the data model aligned, with every spec rule (uniqueness, at most once per list, no quantity in the catalog) traceable to a data-model rule? [Consistency, Spec §Entities, Data Model §Entities]

## First Launch and Seed

- [ ] CHK022 - Is "first launch" or "fresh installation" defined by the state of the stored data (no list exists) rather than by install events, so clearing the application's data or reinstalling seeds again and an existing store is never seeded twice? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-023, Research §R18]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is it specified that an interrupted first launch never leaves a partial seed (some categories and no list), and what the next launch does in that case? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK024 - Does the spec say the catalog starts empty in a way that matches the empty state requirements of the add screen on a fresh install? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §US2-15]

## Schema Evolution

- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements stated for data written by this version surviving a later update of the application (later features change the schema, for example 002 and 003), so an update never loses lists, articles or ticks? [Gap, Spec §SC-007, Plan §Complexity Tracking]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the behavior defined when the stored data comes from a newer version of the application than the one installed (downgrade), or is that case explicitly out of scope? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Offline and Synchronization Boundary

- [ ] CHK027 - Can SC-006 ("100% of the actions ... in airplane mode") be checked against a defined list of actions, matching the list SC-009 uses? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is the conflict between FR-027 ("all data stored on the device, no synchronization") and constitution Principle VII (remote source of truth) recorded in the spec itself, with a pointer to the plan's justified deviation and to 003? [Conflict, Spec §FR-027, Plan §Complexity Tracking]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are the choices kept for a later synchronization (ids made on the device that never change, one saved unit per user action) stated as requirements that 001 must keep, or only as research notes that an implementer may drop? [Traceability, Research §R5, Research §R19]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the loss of all data when the device is lost, reset or the application uninstalled, until 003 ships, stated as an accepted assumption, including whether system backups (Android Auto Backup, iCloud) are expected to hold the data? [Assumption, Gap, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is the expected size of the data stated (number of articles in the catalog, number of lists), so the in-memory search and read-model decisions rest on a written assumption and not only on research? [Assumption, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §R6]

## Privacy of Stored and Reported Data

- [ ] CHK032 - Does FR-030 ("without any list content") cover the messages of storage errors, which can quote the failing value or statement, and is it specified that such messages are stripped before reporting? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030, Contract §ErrorReporter]
- [ ] CHK033 - Is it stated whether the data on the device needs any protection (encryption, exclusion from backups), or is the absence of such a requirement an explicit decision for data judged not sensitive? [Gap, Assumption, Spec §FR-027]
